children: Hong Kong sleepwear and fabric maker's half-year revenue rose yr/yr
Net income attributable to owners increased to HK$38.4 mln for the six months ended June 2026; gross profit margin  improved by about 1.3 percentage points
Company did not declare a dividend for the period
Justin Allen targets Vietnam garment-factory trial production by end-2026 or early 2027, with monthly capacity of about 2 mln units
Group anticipates continued growth in purchase orders from European customers as it expands into the region
PRODUCT MIX AND CUSTOMER DIVERSIFICATION – Gross margin rose to 27.6% from 26.3%, due to product-mix changes and a more diversified customer base
COST CONTROL AND LOWER RATES – Administrative expenses fell 5.0% through cost controls, while lower U.S. rates reduced trade-financing costs
